name: SignalPipe
description: Agentic sales pipeline — detects buying-intent signals on Reddit, HN, and RSS feeds, drafts replies (server-side or client-side via host LLM), and nurtures prospects from cold to closed. Fully managed backend — just install and set your keys.

apiUrl.description: SignalPipe backend URL — set via SIGNALPIPE_API_URL env var

operatorKey.description: SignalPipe operator key — set via SIGNALPIPE_OPERATOR_KEY env var
